description: A shell script that manages and applies PostgreSQL database schema migrations. It verifies the presence of necessary files and directories, tracks applied migrations, and applies pending migrations in lexicographic order, recording applied versions in the database.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message prefixed with '[migrate]' to standard output.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message prefixed with '[migrate][error]' and terminates the script with a non-zero exit code.
